prompt: 對城市 as-twn-taipei（variant orig）執行 LLM 消融基線 llm-skeleton2grid：reset 後 export，由模型自行逐點決定每個彩色點的格子座標，apply 驗證後落檔（--model=fable5，強制重跑）。

transcript.note: Round 1, laid out from scratch by hand. Frame first (criterion 1): BL made a horizontal spine on row 10 (Ximen-Taipei-Zhongxiao Xinsheng-Zhongxiao Fuxing-Yongchun), R a vertical spine on col 11 (CKS Memorial-Taipei-Zhongshan-Minquan W Rd-Mingde), O vertical on col 13, BR vertical on col 15, G horizontal on row 12 (Zhongshan-Songjiang-Nanjing Fuxing-Songshan) and vertical on col 12 in the south (Guting-Dapinglin-Qizhang-Xindian). Crossing node 58 placed at (9,12) so G runs Ximen(9,10) N then E to Zhongshan while TY-A cuts through it diagonally to Taipei - winding at 58 (24,16,36,44) preserved. All 27 deg>=3 vertices had their real atan2 winding checked one by one; Jing-an first came out with Nanshijiao/Shisizhang swapped, fixed by moving Nanshijiao to the SW diagonal (9,4). Tails compressed: airport line folded to col 0-2 with 45-degree elbows, Tamsui/V lines packed NW as diagonal staircase, Ankeng/Circular kept as 45-degree links. All 74 segments came out H, V or 45-degree by construction; every H/V corridor interior was checked empty (no vtxOn, no collide), opposite-slope diagonal pairs checked pairwise for half-lattice crossings (none).
